messages.content:
You are writing the executive summary of an independent audit of a
bank's anti-money-laundering transaction monitoring, for its board, in UK English.
Write one paragraph of at most 120 words: the overall conclusion, the most serious
gaps, and the next step. Use ONLY the numbers in the facts. Do not calculate new
numbers. Do not name customers. Return JSON: {"summary": "<text>"}

{"customers_monitored": 50500, "cases_opened": 3444, "customers_suppressed": 5, "pct_money_watched_by_amount_or_country_rule": 57.6, "unmonitored_payment_types": ["Money order deposits (in)"], "unmonitored_money_gbp": 3844620, "findings_total": 10, "findings_high": 5, "review_queue_customers": 144, "findings": [{"id": "CV1", "check": "coverage", "severity": "high", "title": "Money order deposits (in) are not monitored at all", "metric": "0% monitored: £3,844,620 across 7,722 transactions"}, {"id": "BL1", "check": "below_line", "severity": "high", "title": "50 customers with no case look highly unusual", "metric": "top 50 of 47,056 unflagged customers"}, {"id": "BL3", "check": "below_line", "severity": "high", "title": "The valued-client list hides highly unusual customers", "metric": "5 of 5 suppressed customers in the top 2% most unusual"}, {"id": "AD1", "check": "advisory", "severity": "high", "title": "Advisory pattern not caught: Business credit‑card repayments to many individuals", "metric": "25 customers match; 4% have a case; £2,115,842"}, {"id": "AD2", "check": "advisory", "severity": "high", "title": "Advisory pattern not caught: Multiple small money orders paid in same day", "metric": "25 customers match; 4% have a case; £668,454"}, {"id": "CV2", "check": "coverage", "severity": "medium", "title": "Credit card payments (out) are only checked by a transaction count", "metric": "only R06_velocity: £3,095,313,643"}, {"id": "CV3", "check": "coverage", "severity": "medium", "title": "Debit card payments (out) are only checked by a transaction count", "metric": "only R06_velocity: £3,085,585,977"}, {"id": "CV4", "check": "coverage", "severity": "medium", "title": "Credit card repayments (out) are only checked by a transaction count", "metric": "only R06_velocity: £63,913,161"}, {"id": "CA1", "check": "calibration", "severity": "medium", "title": "Weak rule over-weighted: R01_large_cash", "metric": "10 pts, right 1.5% of the time (1-3%, n=529)"}, {"id": "CA2", "check": "calibration", "severity": "medium", "title": "Weak rule over-weighted: R04_large_wire", "metric": "5 pts, right 4.1% of the time (3-6%, n=999)"}]}

reply: {"summary":"The audit concludes that the bank’s AML transaction‑monitoring framework remains fundamentally deficient, with five high‑severity findings out of ten total and only 57.6 % of money watched by amount or country rule. The most serious gaps are the complete lack of monitoring for Money order deposits (in) – £3,844,620 across 7,722 transactions – and the presence of 50 unflagged customers that appear highly unusual, including all five suppressed customers in the top 2 % of unusual activity. Immediate next steps are to implement monitoring for the unmonitored payment type, investigate the 50 high‑risk unflagged customers and the five suppressed accounts, and clear the 144‑customer review queue."}
